content: Trustworthy body-measurement workflows expose the measurement contract: required inputs such as height, named dimensions, units, anatomical locations or landmarks, measurement method, provider/source, and review state. NIST apparel measurement references distinguish measurement points, distances, and computer processing definitions; Bodygee documents named circumference sites and cross-section visualization; 3DLOOK accepts front and side photos with height in its measurement API. For SukatAI, the user should be able to see what was measured, with which supplied height, by which provider/version, and whether the set is estimated, ready for tailor review, or verified. Source: https://tsapps.nist.gov/publication/get_pdf.cfm?pub_id=821269 ; https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/IR/nistir5411.pdf ; https://docs.fitxpress.3dlook.me/ ; https://support.bodygee.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009570397-Which-measurements-does-Bodygee-provide
